subject: general
question:
Simplify:

5 + [7² – 6 × 4 (12 ÷ 6)] + 7 × (5 – 3)
solution:
Concept Used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

Calculation:

5 + [72 – 6 × 4 (12 ÷ 6)] + 7 × (5 – 3)

⇒5 + [49 – 6 × 4 (12 ÷ 6)] + 7 × (5 – 3)

⇒ 5 + [49 – 6 × 4 × 2] + 7 × (5 – 3)

⇒ 5 + [49 – 48] + 7 × (5 – 3)

⇒ 5 + 1 + 7 × (5 – 3)

⇒ 5 + 1 + 7 × 2

⇒ 5 + 1 + 14

⇒ 20

**∴ The required value is 20**
